caption: The drawing depicts a round object, primarily black in color with hints of brown and yellow highlights, resembling a decorative metal wheel or gear with a floral or petal-like pattern in the center. The wheel has a central hole and is divided by radiating curved spokes that form an intricate, symmetrical design. The outer edge of the wheel is ridged and uneven, adding further texture. Below the wheel, there is a linear, side-view outline of what appears to be the same object, drawn in fine black lines, showing its profile. The name "Elmo Fleming" appears written in script below the outline. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color.
title: Iron Stand
